messages:
Megan L.: kicking off a quick config-only tweak to help midday tail spikes. no model or infra changes. change-id cfg-2026-03-21-xx. target canary 5% for 45m. changes: routing.policy=load_smooth, batch.window_ms 20 -> 12, tenant_rate_multiplier=0.95, idle_timeout_ms 28_000 -> 30_000. DeployBot: queued config-only deploy cfg-2026-03-21-xx, canary=5%, window=45m. monitor: https://console.redwood/change/cfg-2026-03-21-xx OpsBot: canary rollout started at 1748123456. streaming logs to ops dashboard.
Anya: noted a rise in p95 on a small subset of canary hosts after 6m: p95 +18%. sample log: ```batching: mean_batch=1.9 -> 1.2; p95_latency=180ms -> 212ms``` Raul: smaller window reduced batching efficiency, likely more KV cache lookups. cost might tick up. can we pin high-QPS tenants to previous config while we observe? Megan L.: yes — pin top 4 tenants (alpha, beta, gamma, delta) to cfg-prev immediately. DeployBot: pins applied: alpha,beta,gamma,delta -> cfg-prev. action-id cfg-2026-03-21-pins Priya: good call. also add rollback conditions: auto-rollback if errors > 0.6% OR p95 delta > 30% sustained for 8m. attach to canary. DeployBot: rollback rule attached to cfg-2026-03-21-xx: errors>0.6% OR p95_delta>30% for 8m -> AUTO-ROLLBACK OpsBot: alert rule created: escalate to paging if errors > 3x baseline OR sustained p95_delta>40% for 15m. link https://ops.redwood/alerts/6421
Anya: after pins, pinned tenants stable. canary cohort p95 delta is down to ~12% and error rate 0.04%. Recommend reducing canary to 2% and extend to 90m for safer observation. Megan L.: agree. adjust canary to 2%/90m; add release note in change doc with exact keys and pinned tenant list. DeployBot: canary updated: 2%/90m by Megan L.. change doc updated: "routing.load_smooth; batch.window_ms 20->12; tenant_rate_multiplier 0.95; idle_timeout_ms 28000->30000; pinned alpha,beta,gamma,delta; rollback rules attached; canary 2%/90m" Raul: please annotate expected cost impact in notes (small increase per-token due to less batching) and plan to run cost-scan after full rollout. Priya: adding runbook snippet: ```1) if AUTO-ROLLBACK triggers: POST /deploy/rollback -d '{"change_id":"cfg-2026-03-21-xx"}' 2) validate pins: GET /config/pins 3) notify #eng-sre and #product 4) watch metrics for 30m 5) file incident if errors>1% for 10m``` OpsBot: canary stable at 2% after 18m: p95_delta ~12%, errors 0.03%. next status update in 30m. Megan L.: thanks team — no other routing or QoS patches while this is observed. if anyone sees >0.5% errors, call rollback immediately. Reconvene at end of window to decide morning ramp plan. :white_check_mark:
